body.name: All-data Beta histogram posterior
body.construction: Independently over bins, assign \(s_j\sim\mathrm{Beta}(1,1)\) and \(u_{aj}\sim\mathrm{Beta}(1,1)\); update \(s_j\) with the \(N_j\) treatment indicators and update \(u_{aj}\) with the \(N_{aj}\) outcomes in arm \(a\), retaining the prior as the total zero-count fallback. Extend each draw constantly on \(B_j\) to obtain \(\eta=(s,u_0,u_1)\sim\Pi_n\).
